# Spectrea Brand Guide

> The complete brand system for Spectrea — a composable intelligence platform that turns scattered information into compounding intelligence. This index lists the canonical documents an LLM should read to understand Spectrea's voice, visual identity, logo rules, colour system, typography, and component specs.

**Strategic claim (v2, 2026-04-18):** Spectrea is the spectrum of clarity. Everything you know, in one living view — alive with possibility, yours to keep. See it whole. Trust what you see. Build on what you find.

The brand stakes a position around clarity, aliveness, and ownership — readable on its own without any product context. Differentiates from Notion (substrate-only), Stripe (one-accent infrastructure), Anthropic (editorial-research), Linear (austere modern), and Replit / Vercel (developer tooling).

Spectrea is **one character with three inseparable facets** — Reveal (Magician: brings the hidden pattern into view), Ground (Sage: shows the evidence and reasoning), Equip (Creator: hands back the tools to build on what's found). These aren't personas for three surfaces; they're facets of a single gesture present in every brand moment. The emphasis shifts with context (reveal leads marketing, ground leads trust surfaces, equip leads product), but all three are always there. Reveal-without-ground is hype; ground-without-equip is stuffy; equip-without-reveal is tools without a reason. The through-line is encoded in the tagline — *We connect the dots* = see them · trust them · build on them.

The brand combines spectrum accents (Cobalt, Teal, Amber, Rose) with a seven-token Warm Blend neutral ladder (Canvas, Cloud, Pewter, Slate, Iron, Graphite, Ink) to feel both precise and human. Tagline: *We connect the dots.* Pronunciation: /spek-TREE-uh/. Etymology — dual reading: (1) *spectrum* — the full range, the complete view; (2) *revealing* — bringing what was hidden into clear view. Together: the spectrum of clarity.

**Illustration system (v4, 2026-04-19) — universal subject-agnostic prompt + hand-SVG primitives.** One prompt template renders any scene (person at a desk, city skyline, abstract concept, dashboard) in the brand voice via Gemini / Firefly / Imagen. Warmth comes from palette discipline: supporting elements use 20–60% tints of the primaries, never default to neutrals. Subtle depth from a single darker tonal step per rounded object. No outlines anywhere. Hand-coded SVG is reserved for primitives — graph vocabulary, dividers, in-product state dots — not for hero scenes. Full prompt and 8-item checklist at `docs/illustration-prompt.md`. v4 retires v3's two-style split (Editorial Geometry + Living Graph), the atoms/forms/treatments/palette four-layer vocabulary as a generation constraint, the four-channel production matrix, and the `SpectreaFigure` Bauhaus limbs-figure component.

**Signature motion (three primitives):** node arrival (~400ms elastic settle + radial pulse), edge formation (~300ms gradient draw), spectrum shift (~600ms Cobalt→Teal→Amber→Rose traversal as the AI-acted signal).

## Canonical documents

- [Full brand guide (Markdown)](/brand-guide.md): Offline mirror of the live app. The live app at [/](/) is canonical; this Markdown exists for LLM-readable and print use. Covers foundation, voice, logo system (two-forms rule, 11 variants, 3 arrangements), Warm Blend colour system, gradient rules (OKLCH with sRGB fallback, 3-stop primary, 2-stop Cool Duet lockup, three duets), typography (Albert Sans / Lexend / JetBrains Mono), iconography (Tabler, 2px stroke), motion, components, communications, and governance. Includes inline SVG visuals for logo, swatches, gradients, and typography.
- [Full brand guide (PDF)](/brand-guide.pdf): Printable version of the same content.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Spectrea (not "Spectre", "Spectra", or "SpectreAI").
- **Pronunciation:** /spek-TREE-uh/.
- **Tagline:** "We connect the dots."
- **Category:** Composable intelligence platform.
- **Spectrum colours:** Cobalt `#4271DF` · Teal `#00B6A0` · Amber `#E19000` · Rose `#F24260`.
- **Warm Blend neutrals (seven-token OKLCH-even ladder):** Canvas `#FDFDFB` (bg) · Cloud `#F4F4F1` (surface) · Pewter `#97979E` (whisper muted, 2.85:1 — supplementary only) · Slate `#6D6D72` (body secondary, 5.05:1 AA) · Iron `#46464B` (emphasized body, 9.21:1 AAA) · Graphite `#212226` (dark UI surface) · Ink `#18181C` (primary text).
- **Default mode:** light. Canvas is the 60% page ground on marketing, product, slides, PDF. Dark is a parallel mode, not the primary register.
- **Dark surfaces (parallel mode):** role mapping inverts — Ink becomes the canvas, Graphite becomes elevated, Cloud becomes text. Two new tokens complete the hierarchy: **Mist `#B0B0B6`** (muted text, ~8.5:1 on Ink) and **Fog `#2E2F35`** (border / divider). Accents (Cobalt, Teal, Amber, Rose) carry over unchanged — all pass WCAG AA on Ink. Dark bridge washes: Cobalt Deep `#1B2440` · Teal Deep `#0E2E2A` · Amber Deep `#2E2410` · Rose Deep `#2E1218`.
- **Slides:** Canvas-default, Ink for punctuation (section dividers, single-stat emphasis, closing CTA). Target ~80/20 Canvas/Ink; contrast is the point, so dilution weakens both modes.
- **Brand gradient:** `linear-gradient(135deg in oklch, #4271DF, #00B6A0, #E19000)` with sRGB fallback for older browsers.
- **Lockup gradient (LogotypeGradient only):** 2-stop Cool Duet — Cobalt `#4271DF` → Teal `#00B6A0`, applied to the mark stroke only. The wordmark stays monotone (Ink on light, White on dark).
- **Typefaces:** Albert Sans (headings, 600/700), Lexend (body, 300/400/500/600), JetBrains Mono (code, 400).
- **Archetypes (three facets, one motion):** Reveal (Magician) · Ground (Sage) · Equip (Creator). One unified character; every brand moment carries all three. Emphasis shifts with context — reveal leads marketing, ground leads trust surfaces, equip leads product — but no facet is absent.
- **Personality (v2, 4 traits):** Warm · Perceptive · Grounded · Adaptive (each with a guardrail). The brand's discipline and consistency are enforced structurally by the system rules (fixed primitives, fixed palette, fixed motion language) rather than claimed as a personality trait.
- **Voice formula (v2):** "Clarity of explanation + experiential momentum. Tech earns its place by **showing its work**." (Replaces the v1 "explaining the magic" formulation.)
- **Privileged vocabulary (v2, 12 brand-evocative words):** spectrum, clarity, whole, see, reveal, illuminate, surface, connect, compose, compound, alive, transparent. Each builds the brand feeling without product context. Product-specific words (provenance, traceable, auditable, attributed, sourced) are still allowed when describing what the product actually does.
- **Illustration system (v4, 2026-04-19):** universal subject-agnostic prompt for hero scenes (Gemini / Firefly / Imagen) plus tight hand-coded SVG substrate for primitives only (graph vocabulary, dividers, in-product state dots). Warmth via tinted palette supporting elements (not neutrals), single tonal step for depth, zero outlines. Retires v3's two-style split (Editorial Geometry + Living Graph), the atoms/forms/treatments/palette four-layer vocabulary as a generation constraint, the four-channel production matrix, and the `SpectreaFigure` Bauhaus limbs-figure component. See `docs/illustration-prompt.md`.
- **Feature naming convention (v2):** Title-case Proper Nouns without brand prefix. The capital signals "this is a named thing in Spectrea." Generic nouns stay lowercase in prose ("the assistant suggested"). Brand prefix reserved for distinct branded surfaces only — separately-paid tiers, developer surfaces, installable companions.
- **Signature motion primitives (v2):** Arrival (~400ms), Formation (~300ms), Spectrum sweep (~600ms — the brand's signature moment, used sparingly).
